data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/test-catalog-v60.json
data_cdn_meta.description: JSON Schema for test_catalog.json (output of stage 3 propose). Enumerates the action × flavor × outcome × user-action-variant test matrix per spec 60 §K test-catalog-as-unit-tests pattern.
changelog: 1.0.0 (2026-05-07): initial; matches prompts/propose.md v3.2.1 output shape

title: Spec 60 test_catalog.json
description: Test enumeration produced by the propose stage. Per spec 60 §K (test-catalog-as-unit-tests), every (action × flavor × outcome × user-action-variant) combination becomes one test the runner executes during the heal-loop phase.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the propose stage emitted this catalog.

generated_by.description: Provenance of the catalog (which prompt + which session produced it).

tests.description: Enumerated tests. The runner executes each in turn and records the outcome.

name.description: Human-readable test description (e.g. 'send_email - dom_send - sent - auto-save').

action.description: Verb name from the manifest's actions/<verb>.yaml.

flavor.description: Flavor name from the action's flavors[].

variant.description: User-action variant — what the runner does AFTER the recipe fills the form. 'auto' = let the recipe finish; 'auto-save' = press the save button; 'auto-cancel' = cancel mid-flow; 'manual' = pause for a human.

expected_outcome.description: Outcome action name (matches one of the entries in the action's outcomes[]).

fixture_required.description: Does this test need a pre-existing fixture record? (Per intent's fixture_dependencies + requires_state.)

seed_fixtures.description: Fixtures the harness auto-creates before this test runs. Carries from intent's fixture_dependencies.

seed_state.description: UI / entity state preconditions the harness ensures before running. Carries from intent's requires_state.

inputs.description: Inputs to pass to the recipe at execution time.

expected_data.description: Optional. Expected shape of the outcome's extracted data. Used for stronger assertions in the test runner.

skip_reason.description: If set, this test is skipped. Records WHY for eval to surface (e.g. 'requires manual fixture setup, not yet automated').
